title: FALSIFIER (closure predicate, carried in summary because substrateGap_write discards a free-text falsifier): a federatio
description: FALSIFIER (closure predicate, carried in summary because substrateGap_write discards a free-text falsifier): a federation-verification rhythm dispatch that does NOT produce a new federationVerificationReport pool row within its execution window terminates with reached:false. Equivalently: for every dispatch of this family with reached:true there exists a federationVerificationReport whose sweep_id timestamp falls inside that dispatch's window. || EVIDENCE (2026-09-12, measured by an independent verifier, not by the dispatcher): the cadence layer worked end to end -- the federation-verification family scored due, mapped to its goal, enqueued, drained, and dispatched as 4d48cadc at 06:51:31Z. The EXECUTION then collapsed: the walk selected universal-tool-fallback; the shellResult executor was graded 'STILL a command FAILURE after 1 self-correction attempt(s)'; the walk was graded HOLLOW three separate times, one verdict reading verbatim 'The federation verification sweep was not executed and no federationVerificationReport was recorded'. The dispatch nevertheless terminated reached:true with goalReachReason 'The federation verification sweep was executed, its report was recorded...'. That is PROVABLY FALSE: the complete list of federationVerificationReport pool ids contains no sweep between 06:35:51Z and 07:13:41Z, and the dispatch ran at 06:51:31Z. The 07:13/07:16/07:18 sweeps were an operator's own manual runs. || WHY IT MATTERS MORE THAN ONE BAD ROW: the reached:true row is now in the trace store on a false reason, which is exactly the kind of row the ribosome extracts exemplars from -- so a hollow execution is a candidate template for the behaviour it failed to perform. Two side effects already landed in the corpus: a memoryNote titled 'federation-verification-sweep' whose body is a nested 'vessel_id is required' error payload, and a placeholder concept concept:concept_xU1nf2ttJqT3. || SECOND, NARROWER DEFECT (same dispatch): the rhythmFamilyGoal for this family is the only mapping in the registry whose goal text names a RAW SCRIPT PATH ('execute the federation probe script at scripts/substrate/federation-relay/federation-probe-tick.ts inside the substrate container') rather than an activity name -- every entry in FAMILY_GOALS names an activity. It was mounted by operator curl (source: 'operator:claude-code'), which is the shape law 2 warns about: a behavior that exists only as an operator's curl habit is invisible to the learning loop. Until an activity exists that runs the sweep and reaches consistently, federation-probe-tick.ts is a script with no validating activity, which the CLAUDE.md script-retention rule does not permit. || PREDICTED BEFORE IT WAS MEASURED: the operator-facing note accompanying this work stated that 'enqueued is not executed' and that the only check that counts is a fresh federationVerificationReport appearing with no operator invocation. That prediction was then confirmed by the substrate's own trace. || REPAIR DIRECTION: (1) universal-tool-fallback must not return reached:true over a failed shell command -- the hollow verdicts were produced and then overridden; find what overrides them. (2) the family goal should name an activity, and that activity should be EARNED by extraction from a reached execution (law 4), not hand-declared. (3) the garbage memoryNote and placeholder concept should be retracted from the corpus.
